current_evidence: The council's Planning Application Requirements page (updated 5 Aug 2026) links this as the latest Local Validation Checklist, which came into effect on 5 August 2026 and replaced the 15 August 2024 version. The PDF itself is headed 'August 2026'.

issues.detail: Several local requirements were not captured. Affordable Housing Statement (major applications of 10+ dwellings; Local Plan Policy 13). Active Travel England Toolkit (150+ homes, 7,500 sqm+ floorspace or 5ha+; must be submitted at validation or the application is invalid). Streetscene Drawings (proposals including new dwellings). Telecommunications Area of Search (telecoms proposals that could affect amenity). Advertising Drawings and Sections (advertisement applications).
issues.evidence: Checklist Aug 2026: 'Affordable Housing Statement – Major planning applications for 10 or more dwellings'; 'Active Travel England Toolkit – 150 or more homes, 7,500 sqm or more... 5 hectares or more'

issues.detail: Householder, Outline, Listed building consent and Advertisement consent are all marked '(none)'. The checklist applies additional plans to all applications, and site sections/FFL to extensions (i.e. householder). Heritage Statement is explicitly required for Listed Building Consent. Advertising Drawings and Sections are required for advertisement applications. Arboricultural Assessment and Biodiversity triggers (roof-space works, demolition) also hit householder schemes. Meanwhile all 14 captured items were placed under Full planning, mostly marked 'INFERRED'.
issues.evidence: Heritage Statement trigger: 'Listed Building Consent; ... development within or adjoining a conservation area'; Advertising Drawings and Sections: 'Advertisement applications'

issues.detail: The Design and Access Statement and Heritage Statement triggers are garbled. Both are the same fragment about combining DAS and Heritage Statements, followed by location-plan rules ('The plan also must be: a plan of the site as is sited on the day of application...'). The real Heritage trigger (LBC, scheduled monuments, registered parks and gardens, in or adjoining conservation areas, archaeology, designated and non-designated assets) is missing. The DAS is a national requirement, not a local one.
issues.evidence: Grokbot excerpt: 'Such applications can combine a Design and Access Statement and a Heritage Statement. 6 The plan also must be: a plan of the site...'

issues.detail: The Agricultural Land Classification trigger omits the threshold (development on 1ha or more of land currently or last in agricultural use). The 'Ecological Survey' and 'Drainage Strategy' excerpts are mid-sentence fragments, and the 'Existing and proposed site levels' excerpt ('and proposed site sections, FFL and site levels).') drops its trigger (extensions to existing buildings).
issues.evidence: 'Agricultural Land Classification Report – Development on 1 hectare or more of land currently or last in agricultural use'

issues.detail: 'Agricultural / rural workers' dwelling appraisal' is a mislabelled duplicate of the ALC row with identical text. The checklist has no rural workers' dwelling appraisal requirement.
issues.evidence: Both rows: 'Should include a Statement setting out the agricultural land classification and whether the proposals would involve the loss of any Best and Most Versatile...'

issues.detail: Items that are process text, not requirements: the validation timescale ('within 5-10 working days'), the 90% fee return text and the no-refund-after-validation note (tab_items 'Submission rules'), and the 'Pre-application advice' row, which is advice to seek pre-app and not a validation requirement. Two drawing-standard tab_items are duplicates that include the fragment '7 Checklists – The below tables...' / '8 Checklists...'.
issues.evidence: 'The remaining 90% planning application fee will be returned to the applicant.'

issues.detail: BNG ('Developers must deliver a BNG of 10%') and Environmental Statement are national requirements restated in the checklist. They are captured as local Full-planning items without noting that they are national.
issues.evidence: Checklist lists a full BNG package (unless exempt) among the national requirements

issues.detail: The list date 2026-08-01 is inferred from the URL. The council page gives the effective date as 5 August 2026.
issues.evidence: Council page: 'Latest checklist came into effect 5 August 2026'

summary: Grokbot's link is the current August 2026 checklist (effective 5 Aug 2026), but the extraction misses Affordable Housing, the Active Travel England Toolkit, Streetscene drawings, Telecoms Area of Search and Advertising drawings. It also wrongly shows no local requirements for Householder, LBC and Advertisement applications, and it has garbled DAS/Heritage triggers and a fabricated rural-worker appraisal duplicate.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
